title: Act: Add Countdown, RoundBadge and Round fetch in App
summary: Countdown and badge components with getCurrentRound
description: Add getCurrentRound to the client, Countdown and RoundBadge components, and wire them into App using the fetched Round.
acceptance_criteria: Countdown formats HH:MM:SS from an injectable clock

preserve: Existing App tests keep passing with fetch failing gracefully

steps.action: Export interface RoundInfo {id:string;number:number;status:string;starts_at:string;ends_at:string} and getCurrentRound() GETting /api/v1/worlds/the-boys-room/round/current via request

Export formatRemaining(ms) returning 'HH:MM:SS' zero-padded or 'Round closed' when ms<=0; Countdown({endsAt, now=()=>Date.now()}) uses useState/useEffect with setInterval 1000 and clears it on unmount, rendering <time role='timer'>
Export RoundBadge({status}) rendering {status ?? 'Round unavailable'}
steps.expected: Badge shows the status or fallback

steps.action: Add useState round and useEffect calling getCurrentRound().then(setRound).catch(()=>setRound(undefined)); render <RoundBadge status={round?.status}/> and, when round exists, <Countdown endsAt={round.ends_at}/> above SceneView
steps.expected: Playing view shows badge and countdown
